summary: Iteration 14 fully verified. Backend: 14/14 pytest cases pass in tests/test_iteration14.py covering: (1) GET /api/documents/types returns 14 UK types + 12 extensions (pdf, doc(x), xls(x), csv, txt, jpg/jpeg, png, heic, webp) + max_mb=20; (2) POST /api/documents multipart: unsupported .exe → 400 ('unsupported'), unknown doc_type → 400 ('document type'), empty file → 400 ('empty'), 20MB+1 → 413, success returns all required fields {id,title,doc_type,filename,ext,size,content_type,notes,created_at,share_url:null} and title defaults to filename sans extension (e.g. 'TEST_Survey Report' from 'TEST_Survey Report.pdf'); (3) GET /api/documents lists active-project docs, ?doc_type= filters correctly, PUT updates title/doc_type/notes (invalid type → 400), DELETE then 404 on download; cross-user access (GET/PUT/DELETE on another user's doc id) → 404; (4) GET /api/documents/{id}/download works with both Authorization bearer and ?token= query, returns correct bytes and Content-Disposition attachment with original filename; (5) GET /api/documents/zip returns ZIP folders per type (Survey/, EPC/, …), duplicate titles get ' (2)' suffix with contents preserved, ?doc_type=EPC filters, 404 when no docs; (6) POST /api/documents/{id}/share returns .../api/doc/{token}, token is idempotent across calls, public GET /api/doc/{token} HTML contains #doc-title, #doc-type, #doc-download and the title/type, GET /api/doc/{token}/file streams bytes with Content-Disposition, DELETE share → file 404 and page shows 'no longer active'; (7) Documents appear in /api/export documents.csv, DELETE /api/auth/account removes documents, DELETE /api/projects/{pid} removes documents in that project. Frontend (390x844 mobile viewport, Expo web): dashboard documents-card → /documents (documents-screen) with documents-search-input, documents-filter-all, documents-upload-button; upload flow (documents-upload-button → /document-form) — document-pick-button opens file chooser (page.set_input_files), document-title-input auto-prefills from filename (TEST_doc_upload2 from TEST_doc_upload2.pdf), document-save-button is aria-disabled=true until file+type+title then becomes enabled, save returns to /documents and new document-row-{id} appears with correct metadata; document-share-{id} opens document-share-sheet, document-copy-link shows document-share-url (…/api/doc/<token>), public page returns 200 with doc-title/doc-type/doc-download + doc title, 8 document-share-person-{key} rows rendered (5 with phone/WhatsApp, 8 with email), clicking a document-share-email-{key} fires logMessage and GET /api/messages?name=<Dave Miller> shows 'Shared document: TEST_UI_Msg (Other)' kind=document; document-revoke-link turns off link and public file returns 404. Regression check: POST /api/upload with Blob FormData (same code path as receipt-form/media-form/snag-form/branding via src/upload.ts → src/utils/upload.ts) returns 200 with {path} and the file is retrievable via /api/files/{path}?token=.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/documents.py upload_document reads the full file into memory (await file.read()) before the size check — a client can still buffer up to 20 MB per request on the server; acceptable for 20 MB limit but consider reading in chunks and short-circuiting at MAX_BYTES to protect against intentionally slow or many parallel uploads.

routes/documents.py share_document accepts any origin_url string without validating scheme/host. Public share_url is built from body.origin_url, so a malicious caller could persist e.g. 'javascript:…' or an unrelated domain in share_origin and surface it in /documents responses. Validate it's an https URL on your own backend host (same pattern used in email_settings.py).

routes/documents.py download_all & download_document use Query(None) token= plus Depends(bearer); fine, but the ?token= path echoes the user's JWT in server logs/Referer. Consider short-lived signed links (e.g. HMAC(doc_id, exp)) like other download endpoints instead of accepting the raw auth token.

frontend/src/components/document-share-sheet.tsx converts phone numbers assuming UK ('+44' with leading-0 strip) regardless of actual country code — breaks for non-UK stakeholders. Non-blocking given the app is UK-focused but worth noting.

frontend/app/document-form.tsx MIME filter is passed to DocumentPicker but server-side ext check is the real gate; iOS picker occasionally returns mimeType='application/octet-stream' which the backend still accepts because it keys off the extension — good resilience, mentioning for awareness.
seed_data_creation: Each backend test registers a disposable TEST_ user via /api/auth/register (unique email) and deletes it via DELETE /api/auth/account afterwards; cascade delete is verified. Frontend tests uploaded TEST_UI_Doc, TEST_UI_Doc2 and TEST_UI_Msg documents to the demo user, logged two 'Shared document: TEST_UI_…' messages against the 'Dave Miller' stakeholder, and all TEST_ documents + messages + files were cleaned via Mongo (db.documents/db.messages/db.files delete_many with regex ^TEST_) at the end — demo now has 0 TEST_ artefacts and plan stays 'basic'.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend URL env key is EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL (frontend/.env). Auth token on web is in localStorage key 'mba_auth_token' as a JSON-stringified string (JSON.parse before using as Bearer). GET /api/messages requires either name or email query param — passing neither returns an empty list because _match('','') builds a {$in: []} filter. There is no DELETE endpoint for /api/messages or /api/trade-ratings — clean up via Mongo (db.messages.delete_many / db.trade_ratings.delete_many). To upload documents from Playwright, use `async with page.expect_file_chooser()` around clicking [data-testid='document-pick-button'] and fc.set_files(path). The document form must be reached via the Upload button on /documents (which pushes onto the router stack) — navigating directly to /document-form breaks the post-save router.back() with a 'GO_BACK not handled' warning (upload still succeeds, but the user stays on the form).
rca_of_issue: N/A — all iteration-14 document-library features (14 UK doc types, typed uploads with full validation, filter/search, bearer+token download, folder-structured ZIP with dedup, revocable share links + public page/file, export inclusion, cascade deletes on account/project removal) verified end-to-end on backend and frontend; regression on the shared uploader (/api/upload via Blob) also passes so existing photo flows remain intact.
